'''Kav Lepkin''' was the leader of the [[Krayt Draggers]], a [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] with about fifteen members that was based in [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
